01 / FINANCIAL ANALYTICSFinWizard: market data meets news sentiment+

The question

How can historical market behavior and financial news be brought together in an understandable analytical interface?

My contribution

Designed and implemented deep learning models, comparing CNN, RNN, LSTM, and hybrid approaches. Integrated Yahoo Finance data and News API sentiment into a Streamlit decision-support dashboard.

The output

A Streamlit research prototype that surfaces model predictions and experimental buy, sell, and hold signals. The work connects data preparation, model comparison, and communication in a single workflow.

Context & limitations

Demonstrates how multiple data sources can support an analytical decision process. Historical model performance does not establish future trading performance; this is a research project, not an investment service.

View source on GitHub ↗

Chapter on Taylor & Francis ↗

02 / STATISTICAL DECISION SUPPORTNon-parametric test prediction & execution+

The question

How can users choose an appropriate statistical test without navigating every methodological choice on their own?

The approach

Contributed dataset curation, preprocessing, feature engineering, model experimentation, and methodology documentation. The framework uses NLP feature extraction and interpretable machine learning to recommend tests, including Runs, Wilcoxon Signed-Rank, and Mann–Whitney U.

The output

An end-to-end workflow that selects a test, executes it, and returns structured test statistics, p-values, and decision rules.

Context & limitations

Makes analytical workflows more accessible and consistent. Recommendations still depend on correctly specified data, assumptions, and study design.

View source on GitHub ↗

Chapter on Springer ↗

03 / MULTILINGUAL RISK ANALYTICSExplainable phishing classification+

The question

How can phishing detection provide interpretable risk signals across English and Hindi text?

The approach

Developed a framework combining NLP and XGBoost, using SHAP for feature interpretation and SMOTE to address class imbalance.

The output

A graded classification approach that distinguishes low, medium, and high suspicion and helps explain the factors behind a prediction.

Context & limitations

Connects model outputs to risk prioritization. Performance depends on the evaluation dataset and language coverage; classifications require appropriate human review.

View source on GitHub ↗

Paper on IEEE Xplore ↗

04 / ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYTICSAQInsight: exploring air quality across data sources+

The question

How can weather, pollution, traffic, and wildfire information be combined to explore changing air-quality conditions?

The approach

Built a research framework with data collection, preprocessing, visual exploration, clustering, and experimental XGBoost models with SHAP explanations.

The output

Exploratory charts, geographic views, and interpretable model outputs, alongside integrations for weather and NASA FIRMS fire data.

Context & limitations

The shared notebook is an experimental implementation. Some integrations depend on external API access; simulated fallbacks and model validation need to be distinguished from observed results.

View source on GitHub ↗

AQInsight manuscript ↗
